answer.book: Peucer's Latin textbook of spherical astronomy, Elementa doctrinae de circulis coelestibus et primo motu (title page dated 1558): front matter (a Greek prefatory poem, dedication to Duke Augustus, an epigram, chronological tables), then four numbered parts (Pars prima to Quarta), each divided into headed chapters, with diagrams and tables.
